Purpose

The Deal_Master_Wide sheet has one row per deal, as requested. Enter annual financial and patent data in the t−3 to t+3 columns. The Panel_DiD sheet automatically reshapes the wide data into one row per deal-year for R/Stata estimation.
Critical methodological caution

The source workbooks are candidate screening lists, not final mutually exclusive treatment/control groups. This workbook contains 39 deals whose normalized headline also appears in the other source file. Use the Final_Classification and Main_DiD_Decision fields only after deal-level validation.

column1: Recommended workflow
1. Validate the transaction, completion date, control transfer and European scope.
2. Classify the deal using pre-acquisition patent, pipeline, platform and R&D evidence.
3. Resolve overlaps, mixed motives, repeated acquirers and multiple event windows.
4. Enter Bloomberg historical actuals only; keep missing observations blank, never zero.
5. Aggregate Lens records to unique patent families by earliest priority year before entry.
6. Use Panel_DiD for estimation after appending the final treatment and comparison files.
Financial data import completed

Twenty Bloomberg workbooks were reviewed. Eighteen primary files were mapped to 26 control-group deal rows. The duplicate Esteve export was not imported twice, and the Celyad file remains unmapped because no corresponding deal exists in the current control workbook.
Patent data import completed

Fifteen Lens exports were reviewed. Fourteen contained valid applicant/owner matches and were linked to 22 control-group deal rows. The file labelled for Esteve contains Samyang patent records and was not used for Esteve.

Patent-family counts are aggregated by earliest priority year. Raw forward citations are the sum of Lens 'Cited by Patent Count' across retained families. Years inside the observed priority-year range with no retained family are coded as zero; years outside that observed range remain blank.

Important scope warnings: the GSK export is concentrated on Consumer Healthcare/Haleon entities, the Roche export is concentrated on Diagnostics/Glycart entities, and several event windows are only partially covered.
